purpose: Audit whether the two dated white-coloured sister systems can be remeasured from current public image metadata after the frozen Azami observation-level inputs were excluded from the submission-facing repository tree.

iNaturalist.taxon_resolution: active exact scientific-name match at species rank
iNaturalist.strict_environment_filter: geo=true plus record-level rejection of obscured/private coordinates
iNaturalist.flower_annotation: controlled term 12 value 13, reported as an auxiliary count only

GBIF.deduplication_rule: identify iNaturalist-republished GBIF records from occurrenceID/references/institution metadata; do not add them as independent images

predeclared_coverage_classes.ready_for_pairwise_image_pilot: at least 10 strict georeferenced iNaturalist research-grade photo observations or at least 10 non-iNaturalist GBIF image occurrences
predeclared_coverage_classes.limited_pilot: 3-9 eligible records in either nonduplicated source
predeclared_coverage_classes.not_evaluable: fewer than 3 eligible records or unresolved exact taxon

outputs: taxon-level source counts and taxonomy resolution
sampled observation/photo metadata with licences and coordinate usability
next_gate: Only systems in which both sister taxa reach at least limited_pilot proceed to image-trait measurement. Primary pairwise replication requires both taxa to reach ready_for_pairwise_image_pilot under the same source and filter contract.
claim_boundary: Metadata coverage is not phenotype evidence.
A photo count is not an independent biological sample count.
GBIF and iNaturalist records are not independent when GBIF republishes iNaturalist observations.
Public image availability is taxonomically and geographically biased.
No white-lineage architecture, environmental response, adaptation or syndrome claim is made from this audit.
